title: Listen to a design review and write the feedback summary (B2)
summary: Listen to a design review with questions and objections, then write a summary of the concerns, decisions and open questions.
learningObjectives: Follow questions and objections in a design review
Separate concerns, decisions and open questions
Write a balanced summary in English

turns.text: Thanks for joining. The proposal is to move image processing from the web servers to a separate worker service. Today, large uploads slow down page requests, and the new service would take that load away.

I like the direction. My concern is operations. A new service means new deployments, new alerts and one more thing to be on call for. Is a queue and a few more workers on the existing servers not simpler?
It is simpler at first, but the web servers and the workers would still share memory. Last quarter, that caused two incidents. A separate service lets us scale the workers alone.

I have a different concern. The workers will download files from user links. That is a risk for server-side request forgery. I would like an allow list of domains and a network policy that blocks internal addresses.
That is fair, and it is not in the document yet. I will add a security section with both controls.

Then I am fine with a separate service, if we agree on two conditions. First, we use the same deployment pipeline as the other services. Second, we define a limit for retries so the queue cannot grow forever.
Both are reasonable. I suggest a maximum of five retries with a delay that grows each time.
One open question remains. How do we store the original files, and for how long? Privacy will ask.

I do not have a final answer. I will talk to the privacy team this week and update the document. Let us approve the direction today, with the security and retry conditions, and review storage next Tuesday.

gist.question: What is the main topic?
options: A proposal to create a separate worker service
A plan to remove all background jobs for the team
A report about a security incident
correctAnswer: A proposal to create a separate worker service
gist.explanation: Elena đề xuất tách xử lý ảnh khỏi web server.

detail.question: What is Marcus's first concern?
options: The price of storage for the team
detail.explanation: Marcus lo về triển khai, cảnh báo và trực.

detail.question: Why does Elena prefer a separate service?
options: It is cheaper to build for the team
detail.explanation: Elena nói bộ nhớ dùng chung từng gây hai sự cố.

detail.question: What security control does Aisha ask for?
options: A new password policy for the team
detail.explanation: Aisha muốn danh sách miền được phép và chặn địa chỉ nội bộ.

detail.question: What is Marcus's second condition?
options: A faster upload for the team
detail.explanation: Marcus muốn giới hạn số lần thử lại.

detail.question: What remains an open question?
options: Which language to use for the team
detail.explanation: Chưa có câu trả lời về lưu file gốc.

listeningNotes.prompt: Take short notes while you listen; they are not saved.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Điều người review lo có thể sai hoặc rủi ro.
vocabulary.example: Marcus raised a concern about operations.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói a concern about, không nói a concern for khi nói về rủi ro.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Lý do không đồng ý với một đề xuất.
vocabulary.example: There was no objection to the direction.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai: ob-JEC-tion.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Việc phải đạt được để quyết định có hiệu lực.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Nói on condition that khi theo sau là mệnh đề.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Danh sách các mục duy nhất được chấp nhận.
vocabulary.example: We use an allow list of domains.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Viết allow list thành hai từ.

vocabulary.technicalMeaning: Việc chưa có câu trả lời và cần theo dõi.
vocabulary.example: Storage is still an open question.
vocabulary.commonMistake: Open question là cụm cố định.

expressions.example: The main concern raised was the extra operational work.

expressions.meaning: Ghi cam kết của tác giả.
expressions.example: The author agreed to add a security section.

expressions.phrase: The direction was approved on two conditions: ___ and ___.
expressions.meaning: Ghi quyết định có điều kiện.
expressions.example: The direction was approved on two conditions: a shared pipeline and a retry limit.
One open question remains: how long original files are stored.

exercises.question: Which sentence is a balanced summary line?
options: The direction was approved on two conditions: a shared pipeline and a retry limit.
Marcus won the argument and the design was rejected by the group. for the team right now
The review was long and boring, and nobody learned anything new.
correctAnswer: The direction was approved on two conditions: a shared pipeline and a retry limit.
exercises.explanation: Câu tóm tắt cân bằng nêu quyết định và điều kiện.

exercises.question: Điền từ: One open ___ remains: file storage.
exercises.explanation: Open question là câu hỏi còn mở.

exercises.question: Sắp xếp phần tóm tắt.
exercises.explanation: Đề xuất, mối lo, quyết định, câu hỏi mở.

sections.title: Ôn lại từ vựng của bài

exercises.question: Ghép từ với nghĩa của nó.
correctAnswer: allow list - danh sách cho phép
exercises.explanation: Ôn lại các từ đã học trong bài này.

exercises.question: Điền từ còn thiếu: Marcus raised a ___ about operations.
Điền từ còn thiếu: There was no ___ to the direction.

performanceTask.title: Write a design review summary
performanceTask.scenario: After a design review, you write a short summary for people who could not attend.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: From the rough notes of a design review, write a summary in English (60 to 110 words): concerns, decision and open questions. Do not look at the model answer yet.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Write a design review summary in English, 60 to 110 words: the proposal, the main concerns, the decision with its conditions and the open questions.
performanceTask.modelResponse: Design review summary. Proposal: move image processing from the web servers to a separate worker service. Concerns: Marcus raised the extra operational work, and Aisha raised a server-side request forgery risk because workers download files from user links. Elena explained that shared memory caused two incidents last quarter. Decision: the direction was approved on two conditions, a shared deployment pipeline and a limit of five retries with growing delays. Elena will add a security section with a domain allow list and a network policy. Open question: how long original files are stored. We will review it next Tuesday.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Write the summary again in English. Keep the structure and make the conditions clearer.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Write a summary for a different design review, such as a database migration.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Write a summary for another design review without looking at old notes.

artifacts.title: Raw notes: worker service review
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Raw notes. Proposal: separate image worker service. Concerns: ops work (Marcus), SSRF risk (Aisha). Approved with two conditions: shared pipeline, retry limit. Open: storage period. Elena adds security section.

retry.brief: Retry with a database migration design.

artifacts.title: Raw notes: database migration review
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Raw notes. Proposal: move orders to a new database engine. Concerns: downtime (Paulo), data check cost (Mei). Approved if migration runs in two steps and rollback is tested. Open: who owns the cutover date.

transfer.title: Raw notes: new API gateway review
transfer.brief: A new situation: an API gateway.

artifacts.title: Raw notes: new API gateway review
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Raw notes. Proposal: one gateway for all public APIs. Concerns: single point of failure (Ines), latency (Joel). Approved with two nodes in two zones. Open: rate limits per customer.

artifacts.title: Raw notes: caching layer review
artifacts.content: Synthetic training artifact — non-production. Raw notes. Proposal: add a cache for product pages. Concerns: stale prices (Kai), memory cost (Dina). Approved with a five minute expiry and a manual purge tool. Open: cache keys for different countries.

anchors.met: The reader sees the proposal, concerns, decision with conditions and open questions.
anchors.notMet: The decision or the open questions are missing.

rubric.label: Neutral and balanced
rubric.description: The summary treats each view fairly.

anchors.met: Reports views neutrally without picking a winner.
Conditions and owners match the discussion.
